crossPoseComparisons.interpretation: All shared app button and full phrase tile frames compared per state/configuration; no hinge-dependent frame movement established within this pair.

method.frameAgreementIncludes: origin, size, right and bottom edges
method.homeTileClip: Intersect full AX tile rect with fixed browsing Home D and the coherent selected window, and for typing also with the area above keyboardTop. This is geometric cropping, not rendered clipping or physical Snap proof. Capacity is reported only for the home browsing state.
method.reservedOverlapPredicate: strict positive intersection area using raw API rectangles; no epsilon
method.settingsScope: Back is measured against final Home Phrases; Family Setup rows are compared to illustrative 64pt-navigation models, not claimed to implement new Settings reserved-region policy.
method.sourcePoseMapping: Supplied by the simulator operator; camera orientation is not inferred from window size

notVerified: Rendered active-display appearance from XCUIScreen captures; the outer display can be black/inactive.
Physical pointer snapping, Switch Control scanning, dwell or eye/head tracking.
Rendered clipping behavior from the AX scroll-container expansion alone.
Maximum scroll range; trailing tile extent is not a scroll-distance measurement.
Settings Family Setup fold/camera clearance as a new product guarantee; broad Settings/setup reservations remain separate scope.
Strong dwell chain proof from runtime frame snapshots; separate chain-suite receipt is required.
Post-review-fix full native unit gate; not part of this read-only artifact.
